title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
content: <p>About the role</p><p>You will design and run data pipelines in Python and SQL on Snowflake, own data quality end to end, and work with cross-functional stakeholders. Airflow and dbt experience is a plus. You will own the platform from scratch with a small team.</p><p>The base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $190,000 per year.</p>
